canonical_title: Anthropic seeks legal guidance on agents negotiating deals for users
aliases: Anthropic turns to lawyers to help AI agents strike deals
treatment: This is reported exploration, not a product release or adopted policy. Repeat only upon an official published protocol, deployment, experimental methodology or new material finding.
known_facts: Financial Times reported on October 18 (reported 04:00 UTC/13:00 JST) that Anthropic is consulting legal experts about AI agents negotiating on behalf of users.
Reported areas include bargaining, customer disputes, agent-to-agent negotiation norms, and how human authority should be expressed.
Reported consideration of user-signed documents specifying agent permissions is exploratory, not a released feature.
reinclude_only_if: Anthropic publishes official agent negotiation or delegated-authority protocol, research or product capability.
Credible reporting identifies specific enforceable authorization, consent or safety mechanisms and deployment timing.
notes: Reported by FT; no primary company announcement verified. The 04:00 UTC publication timestamp is independently indexed; Oct 18 midday output unavailable.
